scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @latent/web && npm run build -w @latent/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:watch:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,mock,server,web -c gray,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm:watch:shared" "npm:mock" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @latent/shared && npm run typecheck -w @latent/server && npm run typecheck -w @latent/web
